༄༅/ /nag po chen po mched brgyad kyi las mtha' nyer mkhor bsdus pa'i phan thabs man ngag mchog dam pa skyon gyi grangs can bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// nag po chen po mched brgyad kyi las mtha' nyer mkhor bsdus pa'i phan thabs man ngag mchog dam pa skyon gyi grangs can bzhugs so//

dpal mgon brgyad la phyag byas te/ /lus can ma lus skyob pa'i phyir// gdon bgegs rims sogs bsrung ba'i rdzong*| |'jigs med rdo rje'i go cha bstan// dang po sde brgyad spyi bsrung ni// bhi ṣa ra dug gza' dug pa// thal rdor khro gnyer klu bdud rdor// 'dre 'jigs thang chu stag sder dang*// spru nag mu zi ldong ros ser// dngul dang zangs lcags g.yu byi ru// mu men mu tig sbur len dang*// khyung sen phag mche gzig gi sha/ */stong zil gla rtsi tsan+dan gnyis// ga pur rnams ni zhib btags la// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na rak+ṣa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags ni khri tsho gcig /btab ste phye ma mgul du btags/ sde brgyad gnod pas tshugs mi 'gyur// / gnyis pa yams nad bsrung ba ni/ a ru rta bon lha min khrag /rdo rje gnyis dang rtsi thur dang*// shu dag gu gul dpa' bo'i ser// yung ba gla rtsi zhib par btags// oṃ badz+ra mahā kā lā ya// tri sarba a ti dz+wa ra rak+ṣaḥ /sngags 'di 'bum btab phye ma'i sman// mgul btags nang re dri ma mnam| |nad yams kun la nyams nga med// / gsum pa 'brum pa bsrung ba ni/ rtogs dpon gnyis kyi sgro rtse dang*// rus mi mthun gnyis rnga ma dang*// sha mi mthun gnyis rak+ta dang*// 'dre 'jigs thang chu ma gi ta// brig phen khro gnyer kan+dha ka /ldong ros spru nag bab bla dang*// ghid+da'i dang rus gzhob rnams sbyar// zhib btags sngags 'di bye ba bzlas// oṃ shrī he ru ka badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ ar+sha sa ya s+ya koṣ+ṭi rak+ṣa/ zhes gdab phye ma mgul du btags// sna la byugs bdug bu ga dgur// thig le byas pas 'brum bu'i nad// me ltar 'bar yang 'jigs pa bral// / bzhi pa srin 'bu+u bsrung ba ni/ ma ṇi tsha la gur gum gnyis// klu bdul rdo rje rtsi thur dang*// sin+dhu ra dang shing kun rnams// zhib btags sngags 'di 'bum tsho gdab// oṃ ma hā kā lā ya/

rau ga sin+ni pā ta naṃ rak+ṣa/ phye ma mgul du btags pa yis// srin 'bu'i nad las skyob par 'gyur// | lnga pa cham pa bsrung ba ni/ bhi ṣa ldong ros khro gnyer dang*// spru nag yos tshig shing kun dang*// ga pur gla rtsi mu zi rnams// zhib btags sngags 'di khri tsho btab// oṃ ma hā kā lā ya sarba ma ma rak+ṣa/ phye ma mgul btags dud pa bya// cham pa'i mtshon la rdo rje'i khrab// / drug pa mdze nad bsrung ba ni/ glang chen klad pa stag sder dang*// khyung sen phag rgod mche ba dang*// tsan+dan gnyis dang bzang po drug /mu zi nag po mu mer ser// ldong ros bab bla ma gi ta// khro gnyer shing kun ga pur dang*// spru nag rta bon rwa gzhob dang*// dme gri yug mdze rabs chad khrag /mdung rtse rdo sho sbal rgyab rgyus// gser zil tig ta dug mo nyung*// bya rgod spos dang ra dug pa// btsan dug thar nu da dhu ra// mi rta khyi yi sha chen rnams// zhib btags sngags 'di 'bum tsho bdun// btab la phye ma mgul du btags// bu ga dgu ru thig le bya// dgos gal che na rang nyid kyi// dri chur sman sbyar khong du btang*// lus la byugs shing bdug pa bya// oṃ shrī ma hā he ru ka badz+ra ma hā kā lā aṣ+ṭa s+ya koṣ+ṭi rak+ṣaḥ gdab pa'i drag sngags de ltar ro// mdze yis 'dzam gling gang gyur kyang*// 'di dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas// mdze ro khur zhing klu bsad kyang*// rang lus rdo rje'i zhu lub 'gyur// / bdun pa gag pa bsrung ba ni/ rdo rje gnyis dang rtse thur dang*// ga pur shing kun ti mu pa/ /re lcag ug chos ma gi ta// thang shing 'bru rnams zhib btags la// oṃ ma hā kā lā ya tri dun dun shaṃ kir du rā dza tsit+ta phe ku la rak+ṣaḥ sngags tshar khri tsho bzlas la gdab| |phye ma mgrin par byugs shing gdags// gag pa'i nad las srung ba'o// / brgyad pa lhog pa bsrung ba ni/ btsan dug re lcags gze ma dang*/

/g.yer ma nyi dga' a bhi ṣa| |a ru ra khrag bra ba'i brun// dpag bsam ljon pa'i kha chu dang*// 'dre 'jigs khro gnyer ma gi ta// thar nu'i khaṇ+ḍa glang po che// chig thub gdus pa'i khu ba sbyar// skam btags sngags 'di bye ba btab// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā' lā ya/ gu ṇa hṛ da ya/ tri laṃ du sarba dza tri sha sod sod/ hur hur/ dun dun/ rbad rbad/ trig trig /shag shag /raṃ raṃ/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ kha taṃ kha taṃ/ ga ti ga ti/ gnyan rgyud rtsa'i laṃ srang sarba tsakra dz+wa la raṃ/ tsit+ta dz+wa la raṃ raṃ rak+ṣa/ zhes gdab phye ma mgul du btags// bug pa dgu ru thig le bya// rang gi dri chu sman sbyar te| |lto stong dus su cung zad btung*// gnyan gyi grong khyer dbus bzhugs sam// lhog rgod 'bum gyis nyams tshad kyang*// dper na khro chu'i pha bong la// bye mas g.yogs kyang mi gnod ltar// rang lus rdo rje'i sku ru 'gyur/ // dgu pa gnyan tshad rgod bab ste// rgyug 'gyel par+pa ta zhes pa// rims nad 'di yi bsrung ba ni// shu dag gla gul bab ldong dang*// mu zi rta bon cha tshan gsum// rwa gzhob spru nag sbyar btags te// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ sarba tri rā dza dz+wa la par+pa taṃ rak+ṣa/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di 'bum du btab// phye ma mgul gdags bu ga dgur// thig le byas pas gnyan rgod rnams// ma lus 'dus kyang bsrung 'gyur zhing*// par+pa ta la mchog 'di yin// / bcu pa gza' yi bsrung ba ni/ bhi ṣa rgya ro gza' dug pa// lhog dug spru nag rta bon dang*// mu tig ldong ros sdig srin sha// ngang ser sha rnams zhib btags la// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya tri rā hu la ke ta ke ta sarba dza ye se tāl rak+ṣa/ sngags 'di 'bum gsum phye mar btab// mgul du btags shing tshes brgyad dang*// bco lnga bcu dang nyer lnga dang*// gnam stong rnams la dud pa btang*// khyab 'jug snams phrag rum gyur kyang*// gza' brgyad gnod pas tshugs mi 'gyur// /

bcu gcig thog gi bsrung ba ni/ thog gis bsad pa'i mi rus dang*/ */'dzin pa yungs kar thog lcags rnams// zhib btags sngags 'di khri tsho btab// ma hā kā lā ya thog gi ka ḍa sarba rak+ṣa/ zhes btab phye ma spyi bor btags// thog stong bab kyang gnod mi 'gyur| |/ bcu gnyis ser ba bsrung ba ni/ yungs kar gnyis dang rdo rje gnyis// rtsi thur mu zi bya rgod spos// ldong ros spru nag rta bon pa// gci 'khyir thal ba ro sol dang*// dug sna khrag sna sbyar byas te// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya gu ṇa hṛ da ya lha srin sde brgyad kyi ser ba yul gzhan du/ a bh+yo ya bh+yo ma bh+yo du bh+yo ru bh+yo tsa bh+yo sha bh+yo na bh+yo zlog cig /phraṃ hril sarba tsakra ser ba yul pha rol tu bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog rmur rmur nan nan/ zhes pa gong bsnyen khri bzlas la// rdzas la btab cing yul der ni// gal te ser ba byung ba na// sne la phus btab ri sna khrid| |sngags bzlas gong gi rdzas dud btang*// sngags gdab sdigs mdzub ri mo yis// ri la khrid la yul gzhan bsgyur// des ni ser ba bzlog par nges// / bcu gsum chu bo bzlog pa ni/ shu dag thar nu sre mo'i brun// mu zi nag po sbal pa'i sha// dug sbrul sha dang mdze po'i brun// ma nu khrag can sbyar btags la// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ sarba a pa ni ra zlog zlog sgyur sgyur bh+yo bh+yo phro phro/ sngags 'di khri btab phye ma rnams// skyer pa'i phur bu'i nang du bcug /chu bo yong ba'i gdong dag la// dbal rtse bstan te bzhag byas nas// rab gnas bya zhing yungs kar la// gong gi sngags ni mang du gdab// chu bo yong ba'i phyogs su gtor// des ni mtha' yi sa mu dra// yin yang myur du bzlog par 'gyur// / bcu bzhi lus stobs bskyed pa ni/ thog mar g.yer ma nyi dga' yi// thang gis rtsa sgo phye ba la// dug 'don byas pa'i da byid dang*// khyi yi rdo rje sbrang rtsi dang*// gze ma a wa a ru ra// nye shing mkhal sran bre bo dang*// de pho'i sha dang shing mngar dang*// pi pi ling dang skyu ru ra// til dkar mon sran dre'u dang*// ra thug rlig pa nas rjen rnams| |zhib btags sngags ni brgya rtsa btab// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya in+d+ri badz+ra ya swā hā/

zhes btab phye ma zhogs re bzhin// lto stong dus su thun re re// 'o mas phul la legs btang na// bde ba rgyas shing thig le 'phel/ /rdo rje mkhregs shing 'od du 'bar// brag la brgyab kyang 'bigs par nus// / bco lnga rkun jag 'ching ba ni/ gri rgyus shi skra khyi spu dang*| |byang gi pho 'brong rnga ma rnams// bzhi sgril phyir bkal 'dom gang la// rdo rje'i mdud pa bdun dang ni// pad+ma'i mdud pa drug spel rgyab// lag bsdogs byas la sngags 'di btab| |oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya sarba chom rkun jag pa thams cad mthu stobs blo yid sems ngag lag dang bcas pa/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ya chings shig lkugs shig rengs shig sdoms shig bying zhig dam par chings shig rak+ṣa/ zhes pa 'bum tsho gsum bzlas gdab/ rtag tu rang gi lus la bcang*// dgos gal che dus srad bu la// rkun jag gang yin dgug gzhug bya// sngags tshar mang nyung skabs sbyar btab// chom rkun thams cad bcings par bsam// jag ching zab pa'i mthar thug yin// bden rdzun lag tu longs dang shes// / bcu drug g.yul las rgyal ba'i thabs/ bye ma la ni sngags 'di gdab// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya ra ma tsa na ha nu man+ta par kha rā le ha nu man+te laṅkā ti ya sa lo dha ra ma ṇīka ra khaṃ ḍā bā' hu ti ya dza sid+dha shrī rām ka dz+nya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces pa'i sngags 'di khri tsho btab// bye ma dgra yi dmag la gtor// rang phyogs rgyal ba the tshom med// / bcu bdun gcan gzan kha 'ching ni/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ ru ru mu kha dha ṇim/ ru ru mu kha maṇo laṃ pa so tshu tsho dha ka ṇa e pa ṇa tsho dha a ha ro pa na dzā har+ṇa ro dza mar mar kha he e ha bha tshin+dha ka ra ma hā dhe ki pū dzo ka ra a shwa bha tsha hūm̐ phaṭa/ sngags 'di gong bsnyen 'bum bzlas la// dgos dus ci mang bzlas pa'i skabs// gang du thos pa'i sa phyogs su// gcan gzan gnod pa 'byung mi srid// khyi ra kha 'ching rkyang pa la// sngags 'di lan gsum bzlas byas la// thal mo brdabs pa tsam gyis chog

/gcan gzan kha 'ching shin tu zab// / bco brgyad mtshon gyi bsrung ba ni/ pad+ma rak+ta gri khrag dang*// yungs dkar gi wang ga pur dang*// sin+dhu ra dang spre ta ka /u ra tha rnams zhib btags te// sngags 'di 'bum khrag bzhi tsam gdab// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā yā yashaṅkhan sarba tsakra tu sa du ra ma ma ya rak+ṣa/ zhes btab phye ma mgul du gdags// do gal che na kha ru bza'// gri mdung mda' rdo ra sogs kyi// char pa bab kyang nyams nga med// / de ltar mgon po mched brgyad kyi// las mtha' phan thabs bco brgyad ma// mgon po'i bsnyen pa thems pa gces// bsnyen pa thems nas 'bad med 'grub// de min nus pa 'byung mi srid| |'di ni mgon po mched brgyad kyi// phan thabs las mtha'i rnam grangs su// dge slong dharma kirtis sbyar// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
